activity.notes: Dmitry Ivanovich, later called Donskoy after the 1380 victory at Kulikovo, ruled Moscow from 1359 until 1389. ATLAS binds this closed Moscow rulership to the existing Grand Duchy of Moscow polity; his separate Grand Prince of Vladimir title is not duplicated as a second representative Activity here.

sources.citation_text: The biographical entry gives his Moscow reign from 13 November 1359 to 19 May 1389 and distinguishes his later Grand Principality of Vladimir.
